Definition: from a presumed compound of G5207 and a derivative of G5087; the placing as a son, i.e. adoption (figuratively, Christian sonship in respect to God):--adoption (of children, of sons).
BiblicalUsage: huiothesía means adoption (of children, of sons). In Romans 8:15, the text says "but ye have received the Spirit of adoption." In Romans 8:23, the text says "waiting for the adoption."
TheologicalSignificance: I believe huiothesía shows us that grace is God giving what we could never earn, and never taking it back. That shapes how I read the passages where it appears: not as filler, but as God's own wording for what He is doing.
